summary: Bound native browser vision screenshots before provider patch limits
description: browser_vision attaches full-page PNGs directly to native-vision model requests. Tall screenshots can exceed OpenAI Codex 30000 image patches, poison session history, and terminate the run with HTTP 400. Add provider-safe preflight resizing while retaining the original screenshot artifact.
acceptance: A 1273x31554 browser screenshot is attached natively below 30000 32px patches instead of raw full resolution.
Normal-sized browser screenshots remain byte-identical on the native fast path.
The original full-resolution screenshot remains on disk and metadata still points to it.
